BiblicalUsage: The putting off of the body of the sins of the flesh — Paul calls circumcision made without hands the putting off of the old nature, done by Christ himself. It happens once, and it is God's work, not mine.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that my old life was not improved but put off, and Christ did the putting off.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
